Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka were simply unable to get anything to work tonight. Their bowlers refused to fire, restrict runs or get wickets when needed. Their fielding too disappointed, with missed opportunities galore. This is going to be a herculean task for the hosts. Join us shortly for the run chase!

We have just witnessed magnificence personified and it is called Glenn Maxwell! He has single-handedly taken Australia to the highest T20I score ever. Everything that he played today turned to gold and adversely, the Lankan bowlers fell to pieces around him. Warner started things off well, Khawaja was even better and Head was the perfect support in an event that culminated in epic fashion.

OUT! TOO LITTLE, TOO LATE! A low full toss angled in, Travis leaps out of the crease and looks to slog it but isn't able to get completely behind it. It flies to Dhananjay de Silva who pouches it with both hands. That's the last ball and AUSTRALIA END THEIR INNINGS ON 263/3!
SIX! CLOBBERED! Head is on fire here. He charges down the track and smashes that one on a full toss. It sails over mid-wicket and above the fence for a maximum.
The 100-run stand is up! In just 38 balls!
FOUR! DOWN THE GROUND! Full around off, Head drives it past the bowler and the ball races to the mid off boundary.
FOUR! GUIDED! Full down the leg side, Maxwell flicks it gently down the leg side and the ball goes behind for a boundary at fine leg.
Angling wide outside off, Maxwell doesn't let it go, punching it through point for a single.
Full down the leg side, Head looks to drive it down the ground but the ball takes an inside edge and goes to the leg side for a single.
THISARA PERERA to bowl the final over...
Fullish ball outside off, Maxwell is ready with a reverse paddle but misjudges the length and misses it. This might be the first reverse sweep that the Big Show has missed tonight!
Low full toss on middle, sliced through cover-point for a couple.
Full on the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.

SIX! Up and away! Fullish ball outside off, Head slogs it over mid-wicket. There is a lot of bottom hand in that shot, sending it higher than it went long and it arcs over the ground, falling just past the ropes for a maximum.
FOUR! CARVED! A low full toss outside off, Head gets down on down knee, pummelling the attempted yorker through extra cover for a beautiful boundary.
Fuller ball outside off, whipped through mid-wicket for a couple. Good running between the wickets from the Aussies.
SURANGA LAKMAL is back on.
FOUR! FLICKED! Excellent shot by Maxwell. Full toss on middle and leg, Maxwell plays an innovative flick shot and the ball races across the ropes.
A low full toss on the stumps, driven through mid on for a couple.
Full outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Full on the stumps, Head for a simple flick of the wrists and sends the ball bounding through the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary.

DROPPED! Sri Lanka had their breakthrough and let it go! Fullish ball outside off, Head slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. De Silva in the deep reverse cups his hands but the ball bounces out of his hands. How much more costly will that be?
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman for a single.
RAJITHA is back on.

Looks for another glory hit but Senanayake fires it in the blockhole and Glenn can only push it towards covers for a single. 23 from the over, Australia on track to reach their highest ever T20I score!
SIX! Three in a row! He is not even bothering to look where the ball is going. He jogs down the track a touch and swings it massively over long on.
SIX! He goes again! Full and around middle, Maxwell gets down and slogs it over long on once again.
SIX! Tonk! Full ball around off, Maxwell heaves it over long on and clears the ropes easily! 200 UP FOR AUSTRALIA! This is also now the highest individual T20I score against Sri Lanka.
Sees Maxi charge out at him and fires it down the leg side. The batsman manages to kick it away.
FOUR! Welcome back! Full toss around off, Maxwell reverse sweeps it over point and gets a boundary!
SACHITHRA SENANAYAKE is back on.
Length ball on the stumps, Maxwell looks to play it off the front foot but is hit on the pads. The umpire signals Leg Bye.

SIX! SLICED! Everything is going right for Maxwell! Fullish ball outside off, Maxwell lofts it over the covers. The ball is low but it keeps going, passing over the fielder in the deep for a maximum. Lakmal does not look happy.
FOUR! PUT AWAY! Full toss on middle and off, Maxwell pulls it finely through the leg side and it passes the ropes at backward point.
Driven through the covers by Travis for a single.
Full on leg, driven through mid on for a single.
MAIDEN T20I Hundred for Glenn Maxwell! Fastest by an Aussie as well!

NO BALL! Dropped as well! A massive full toss outside off, Maxwell looks to pull it for a couple. The ball takes a top edge and soars over backward point. Dilshan get in position with both hands outstretched but the ball pops out of his palms. Maxwell takes off his helmet and beams at his team mates. He is back with a bang!
Full and wide outside off, Head stretches across and plays it to mid off for a comfortable single.
SURANGA LAKMAL is back on.
FOUR! One bounce and across the ropes! Maxewell gets the shot he was looking for! Full on leg, Maxwell gets into position early and scoops it over point for a boundary. Maxwell is on 98 now.
Fullish ball on the stumps, played to the covers. The fielder aims a clumsly through throw and misses. The batsmen seize the opportunity to run a second.
FOUR! SLASHED! Short outside off, Maxwell goes after that slower delivery, cutting it through the covers for a boundary.
Full on the pads, Head flicks it through the leg side for a single.
BEATEN! Fullish ball outside off, Head looks to slog it but misses his swing.
Full toss on leg, Maxwell holds his ground to reverse sweep it through point for a single.

SIX! Thwack! No waiting game for Head here! Flighted outside off, Head comes down the track and swings it massively over mid-wicket for a maximum! Bitter sweet over for Pathirana - A wicket but 16 runs of it as well. 4-0-45-1 he ends up with tonight.
Full and outside off, swung down to long on for a single this time.
FOUR! He and his reverse sweeps. A helmet-less Maxwell takes this from leg stump and dispatches it over point for a boundary!
Comes down the track first ball and works it through square leg for a single.
TRAVIS HEAD walks in at number 4, replacing Khawaja.

OUT! Gone this time. A bit of more flight this time, outside off, very full in length, Khawaja comes down the track and lofts it down the ground. Is not quite able to clear the man at long off and Thisara Perera takes it with ease. Did not realize this, but that ends the 97-run stand. Useful knock from Khawaja as well.
FOUR! Fine shot. A full toss outside off, Khawaja comes down the track and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Khawaja has done well to keep that yorker at bay. They pick up a single.
SIX! DONE WITH EASE! Full around off, Khawaja lofts it over mid-wicket and it soars across for a boundary.
Down the leg side, Khawaja looks to scoop it but it goes to the keeper. Luckily for him, it doesn't carry.
Full around off, Maxwell is hit low on the pads for a single.

SIX! WAS THAT OUT? No, it's a six! Fullish ball on off, Maxwell slogs it cleanly over mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep catches it at the ropes. He steps across the ropes and there the umpire has to refer that one upstairs. The replay shows that he caught it but his foot went on to touch the line. The umpire raises arms to that one.

Maxwell tops himself! This is his highest T20I score! Fullish ball on middle and off, Maxwell looks to reverse sweep it but miscues it to third man. The batsmen look to sneak in a second but there is a direct hit on the striker's end. The umpires refer it upstairs and the replays show that the batman was well inside. They get away with a couple.
Run out appeal! There has been a direct hit at the striker's end and the Lankans have appealed for the same. Usman Khawaja is the man in question.
THISARA PERERA is brought back on.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Maxwell sweeps it fine down the leg side. It makes it through the gap and across the ropes.
Full around off, whipped through mid-wicket for a  boundary.
FOUR! THROUGH THE GAP! Fullish ball on the stumps, Maxswell slogs it through mid on for a boundary.
This one drifts in, Khawaja looks to run it down to third man but gets a bottom edge towards point. A quick single taken.
Good use of his wrists there, comes down the track and works it wide of long on. Sachithra Senanayake has to cover good ground to his left and slides to stop the ball. Two runs taken.
Comes down the track and whips it down to long on for a single.
Full on middle, driven through mid on for a single.
Shortish ball outside off, Khawaja gets a bottom edge on that one for a single.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side for a single.
SIX! CRACKER! Floated around off, Maxwell slogs it over mid-wicket. He is on fire and it is evident in the fierceness of that shot as it flied into the crowd.
Flatter ball down the leg side, flicked off the pads for a single.
Landed around off, Maxwell rocks back and punches the ball through the off side for a single.
SACHITHRA SENANAYAKE is back on.
Khawaja works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
50-stand is up in just 29 balls!
SIX! Full on off, Khawaja gets down the track and smashes it down the ground for a maximum.
Landed outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
Full delivery on middle and off, Maxwell bounds forward and drives the ball. It goes through the off side and the batsmen come for a second. It was a risky run but they get away with it.
Flatter ball outside off, played to point for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven through mid off.
Shortish ball outside off, Maxwell looks to play it but misses.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.

SIX! BACK-TO-BACK! Full toss on the stumps, Maxwell flicks it through mid-wicket. It goes up and comes down near the ropes. The fielder in the deep stretches up to catch it but the ball just goes over for a maximum.
3rd T20I fifty for GLENN MAXWELL.

SIX! MASSIVE! Full around off, Glenn makes room for it and smashes the ball over mid on. The ball soars into the air and there is no doubt that monster of a shot has sent that one sailing across the ropes for a maximum.
Maxwell has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Full delivery, outside off, Khawaja gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. They pick up a single.
Landed outside off, Khawaja looks to play it but misses.
Served outside off, Maxwell sweeps it crisply through mid-wicket but de Silva is there to stop it. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floats a full delivery around off, driven to Chandimal at extra cover.
Full on off, driven through mid-wicket for a  single.
Loopy ball on middle, flicked through square leg for a single. The batsmen look for a second but don't get it.
SACHITH PATHIRANA to bowl.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed to the cover region by the batsman for a single. Australia are off to a punishing start.
FOUR! Excellently done! Full and floated around off, Maxwell drives it hard with the bottom half of the bat and the ball soars over the covers for a boundary. The crowd falls very silent.
Full outside off, driven through mid on.
Khawaja has played it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss on the stumps, driven through mid off for a single.
DHANANJAY DE SILVA to bowl.
Floated outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
This is Australia's highest power play score.
Maxwell gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side for a brace.
FOUR! Well struck! Full on middle and off, Maxwell opens the face of his bat, and drives it through mid off for a boundary.
Full outside off, driven through the covers.

FOUR! AUDACIOUS! Maxwell shows his adaptabiltiy with that shot! Full and down the leg side, Maxwell changes his shot mid-way, sweeping him through the square leg for a boundary. Bravely done by Khawaja to play a sweep to a fast bowler.
FOUR! Thunderous! Full and outside off, Maxwell goes hard and slices it over covers for a boundary!
Landed around middle, worked through square leg for a single.
THISARA PERERA comes into the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat for a single.
USMAN KHAWAJA comes in at number 3, replacing Warner.

OUT! CASTLED! Warner goes for it again but Sananayake has the last laugh. Flighted and slower outisde off, Warner gets down on one knee for a pre-meditated slog sweep. It spins into him and he misses his sweep. The ball passes the inside edge of the bat and crashes into the stumps.
A short ball around off, heaved towards mid on.
A full toss now, Maxi aims for a hat-trick of sweeps and just eludes the man running back at cover. A single taken.
FOUR! He goes again! Similar ball, similar shot, a slightly different result. Maxwell brings out the reverse sweep again, this time over cover-point, for a one-bounce boundary.
SIX! Kaboom! A full ball around leg, Maxwell brings out his famous reverse sweep and gets it all the way over covers!
SACHITHRA SENANAYAKE is back on.
FOUR! Fullish on off, Warner drives it hard over the bowler's head. The ball is going at tremendous speed and the bowler has to chance to catch it. It goes down the ground for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Warner looks to cut it but is beaten by the bounce.
Length ball outside off, Warner uses the pace to guide the ball to point for a couple.
Low full toss on leg,  pushed to extra cover for a single.
Warner tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The Umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Maxwell drives this one hard through mid off. The ball races drown the ground and crosses the ropes.
Length ball down the leg side, Warner looks to play it but misses and the ball hits his pads. There is a call for LBW but the umpire disagrees and signals a leg bye.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Low full toss outside off, Warner doesn't wait for it, stepping forward and driving it through the covers and to the fence.
FOUR! Shortish ball outside off, Warner square cuts it through cover-point and the ball races for a  boundary.
FOUR! Full on middle and leg, Warners steps forward and slogs it over mid-wicket. The ball passes over the fielders and goes across the ropes.
FOUR! Right in the slot! Full outside off, Warner stays right in his crease and lofts it over mid on for a massive boundary.
Fullish ball outside off, Warner looks to drive it and the ball takes the inside edge and goes to mid-wicket for a couple.
KASUN RAJITHA comes into the attack.
FOUR! SMASHED! Full and wide outside off, Maxwell drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Shortish ball outside off, cut through point for a single. Mendis dives left and makes a fantastic save.
FOUR BYE! Short and wide outside off, Warner look to cut it but the bounce beats him. It passes over the keeper and goes on to the third man boundary.
Fuller ball outside off, heaved through square leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! Length ball outside off, Maxwell looks to slog it but overestimates the swing and the ball beats the bat's inside edge.
Length ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Down the leg side, Maxwell looks to flick but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
SURANGA LAKAMAL to bowl from the other end.
Floated outside off, driven through the covers.
Tossed up around off, swept through mid-wicket for a brace.
Flighted outside off, reverse swept through square leg for a single.
Flighted across the batsmen, he goes for a reverse sweep but misses.
Floated full toss around off, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended back to the bowler.
Players are out in the middle. DAVID WARNER and GLENN MAXWELL will open the batting. Sri Lanka will start with spin. SACHITHRA SENANAYAKE will bowl the first over.

David Warner says that never change your winning ways on his call of Heads. He says it looks a nice surface and it will challenge their bowlers to bowl. Maxwell and Henriques comes in, he says. Bailey is also in, as he was asked to stay back as a cover for the injured players. Warner adds that losing Finch and Lynn to injuries is a big blow.
Dinesh Chandimal says that the dew factor will come into play. He says that they have to forget about the ODIs and start afresh and hence have made 6 changes.
TOSS - It's time for the flip of the coin. David Warner calls it wrong again. However this time, SRI LANKA HAVE ELECTED TO BOWL.

PITCH REPORT - Damien Martyn says that there is not much grass present, just a few cracks here and there and it's dry. It's going to be hard and pacy. It will skid with the new ball like it did in the last match and also will have some turn. Ends up by saying that it's going to be a fantastic T20 surface.

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, would look to make a comeback after they were outplayed by the visitors. Their batting has disappointed in the ODI series and will look to make an improvement. Let's hope we have an entertaining match. Stay tuned for the Toss.

A warm welcome to all of you to the first T20I between Sri Lanka and Australia. Australia after losing the Test series came back strongly in the ODIs and won it 4-1. Now we move on to the shortest format of the game and Australia haven't won a T20I game in Sri Lanka against them and would look to change that.
